item.title: Medline Industries, LP: Medline Micro-Kill Bleach Germicidal Bleach Wipes, 12" x 12", 110 Count Bag, Product Number MSC351450BG4 Recall
item.product: Medline Micro-Kill Bleach Germicidal Bleach Wipes, 12" x 12", 110 Count Bag, Product Number MSC351450BG4
item.summary: Medline Micro-Kill Bleach Germicidal Bleach Wipes may exhibit a reduction in bleach concentration to levels below specification prior to the end of the labeled 12-month shelf life. Reduced bleach concentration may compromise the effectiveness of disinfection, potentially allowing for the survival and persistence of pathogenic microorganisms. Product details: Medline Micro-Kill Bleach Germicidal Bleach Wipes, 12" x 12", 110 Count Bag, Product Number MSC351450BG4
item.affectedPeople: US Nationwide distribution in the states and territories of Guam, Puerto Rico.
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
